data.goal: hand-read practitioner discussions in medical device fault code domains (AAMI forums, HTM groups, biomed engineering communities) to establish whether real unserved need population exists, before any classifier is written

data.next: hand-read practitioner discussions in medical device fault code domains by direct community access (AAMI forums, HTM groups, biomed engineering communities) to establish whether real unserved need population exists, before any classifier is written
data.summary: Hand-reading of practitioner discussions in medical device fault code domains: web search for AAMI/HTM communities attempted but not yielding accessible results through current interface. View-count principle on FDA device recall narratives: 46% served (incidental keyword matches), 54% unserved (problem descriptions), 0% partially_served. G4 code concentration (top 20 FDA device problem codes = 47.6% of reports) already passes from bulk data analysis. Per D083/D095: fresh observation in new domain requires practitioner access; seven domains closed on instrument grounds, never on population grounds. Next: hand-read practitioner rows in medical device domains (AAMI forums, HTM groups) by direct community access before any classifier written.
